name: giant rat
description: A rat the size of a dog, with yellow teeth and a scabrous hide. Its eyes catch the light like wet coins.
death_message: The giant rat shrieks once and goes limp.

name: skeletal guard
description: An ancient soldier, still in rusted plate, animated by something that refuses to let it rest. Its empty sockets track your every move.
death_message: The skeletal guard's bones clatter apart and fall to the floor. At last, it is still.

name: old hermit
description: A wiry old man in a patched cloak, carrying a gnarled staff. His eyes are sharp despite his age. He doesn't seem hostile — just watchful.
dialogue: Aye, I know this keep well. Spent twenty years here before the wraith drove me to the wood. Watch yourself in the undercroft — that thing is old and angry. I can tend your wounds if you have coin.

name: cave spider
description: A pale spider roughly the size of a dinner plate, clinging to the hollow tree's inner wall. Its movements are quick and deliberate.
death_message: The cave spider curls its legs inward and drops from the wall.

name: undercroft wraith
description: A shape that is more absence than presence — a cold outline of a person that drifts a few inches above the flagstones. Where it passes, your breath fogs.
death_message: The wraith lets out a sound like tearing paper and dissolves into nothing. The cold lifts.
